s: XZ - YZ = 2 h - P = 2 . . . . . . . (i) h 2 = (2√6) 2 + P 2 h 2 - P 2 = (2√6) 2 (h - P)(h + P) = 4 × 6 (2)(h + P) = 24 h + P = 12 . . . . . . . (ii) Adding equation (i) and (ii) 2h = 14 h = 7, P = 5 $$\begin{aligned} & \sec {\text{X}} + \tan {\text{X}} \\ & = \frac{{\text{h}}}{{{\text{XY}}}} + \frac{{\text{P}}}{{{\text{XY}}}} \\ & = \frac{7}{{2\sqrt 6 }} + \frac{5}{{2\sqrt 6 }} \\ & = \frac{{12}}{{2\sqrt 6 }} \\ & = \frac{6}{{\sqrt 6 }} \\ & = \sqrt 6 \end{aligned}$$
